summary: Tested Category Management CRUD features (backend + frontend). Found and fixed a critical Metro cache issue causing old bundle to be served. All backend tests pass (29/29). Frontend category management fully functional after cache clear.

critical_fix_applied.issue: Metro transform cache (295MB) was stale, serving old bundle without new category management features (Add button, edit/delete buttons, 'Manage Categories' title were missing)
critical_fix_applied.fix: Cleared /app/frontend/.metro-cache/cache and restarted Expo (sudo supervisorctl restart expo)
critical_fix_applied.impact: ALL new category management UI features were invisible before fix; now fully working

minor.issue: Returns 401 if session_token not in MongoDB user_sessions (expected behavior for auth). Session management via localStorage works correctly.

issues: 'Create Category' / 'Save Changes' button requires scrolling down on small screens (390px height) due to large icon picker grid (41 icons × 7 rows). Not a bug but a UX consideration.
Multiple 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' warnings - minor CSS deprecation, no functional impact

tests_covered: GET /api/workspaces/{id}/categories - returns 10 default categories with all required fields
GET /api/workspaces/{id}/categories - all 10 defaults present (Bakery, Beverages, Dairy, Frozen, Household, Meat, Other, Pantry, Produce, Snacks)
POST /api/categories - created category persists in GET
DELETE - items moved to 'Other' category after deletion
Frontend file: new icons (shirt-outline, medical-outline, sparkles-outline, etc.) in AVAILABLE_ICONS

features_verified: Pricetags icon in header opens Manage Categories modal
Modal title shows 'Manage Categories' with '+ Add' button and X close button
All 10 default categories present in modal
Edit (pencil/blue) and Delete (trash/red) buttons on all categories except Other
'Other' category has NO action buttons (confirmed at y=628 in modal DOM)
Clicking Add button opens 'New Category' form with name input, color picker (15 colors), icon picker (82 icons)
Category name input updates preview in real-time
Create Category works (verified via JS click + API)
Edit Category form pre-fills existing category data (tested with Bakery)
Delete Category opens confirmation modal with message 'Bakery will be deleted. All items moved to Other'
Delete cancel returns to category list with item still present
Duplicate name shows error 'Category with this name already exists'

action_items: INFORMATIONAL: Metro cache was stale and needed clearing - this is already fixed. Main agent should note that if code changes aren't appearing, clearing /app/frontend/.metro-cache/cache and restarting expo fixes it.
MINOR: Consider whether the 'Create Category/Save Changes' button scrolling issue should be addressed with sticky bottom button or reduce icon grid height.
MINOR: shadow* deprecation warnings in Expo web console - consider migrating to boxShadow style
critical_code_review_comments: Metro cache management: When deploying code changes, the Metro transform cache may need to be explicitly cleared for lazy-loaded bundles to pick up changes. This was the root cause of the main testing issue.
The /api/categories POST endpoint correctly validates duplicate names (case-insensitive) and returns proper 400 error with detail message.
The DELETE /api/categories/{id} endpoint correctly moves items from deleted category to 'Other' before deleting.
Frontend code correctly prevents edit/delete buttons from rendering for 'Other' category (cat.name !== 'Other' check works).

The AVAILABLE_ICONS list in frontend has 41 icons covering all required new icons (shirt-outline, medical-outline, sparkles-outline, happy-outline, phone-portrait-outline, flower-outline, grid-outline, aperture-outline, bandage-outline etc.)

rca_of_issue.root_cause: Metro bundler transform cache (295MB) was serving a stale compiled version of index.tsx. The lazy=true bundle parameter caused Metro to serve the cached (old) bundle instead of recompiling from the updated source file.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: Before fix: accessing https://mobile-state-sync.preview.emergentagent.com showed category modal with only 'Categories' title, no Add button, no edit/delete buttons per category. The bundle served via lazy=true did not contain 'Manage Categories', 'addCategoryBtn', or 'pencil-outline'.
rca_of_issue.fix: Cleared /app/frontend/.metro-cache/cache directory and restarted Expo server. The new bundle now contains all new code.
rca_of_issue.prevention: If code changes don't appear in the browser, clear Metro cache: rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache/cache && sudo supervisorctl restart expo
